title: SimWorld seed water file (water.json)
description: Low-poly water of a region (sea, lakes, large rivers), written by `simworld-cli seed water` from OSM data (docs/spec-world-seed.md section 4.4). Inside bbox, outside every polygon is land; outside bbox the surface is `outside`. Coordinates [lon, lat], quantized to 1e-7 degrees.

format.description: File format version. This library reads 1.

source_date.description: Date of the source data, YYYY-MM-DD (optional).

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in degrees: the region the polygons describe.

outside.description: Surface outside bbox (required): sea or land.

tolerance_m.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance the file was simplified with, meters (informational).

min_area_m2.description: Slivers under this area were dropped, square meters (informational).

polygons.description: Water polygons. Outer rings counter-clockwise, holes clockwise (GeoJSON order).

kind.description: sea (flat at terrain.sea_level_m), lake (flat at its own level), river.

rings.description: Outer ring first, then holes. A ring may repeat its first point at the end.
